notes.title: Demo Update: Better performance + smoother animations
notes.notes: [p]v0.3.5.7 – Demo Update: Better performance + smoother pre-race track & vehicle animations[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update: New moving obstacles, AI improvements
notes.notes: [p]V.0.3.4.0 – New moving obstacles, smarter AI, smoother controller navigation, and bug fixes![/p]

notes.title: Demo Major Update: Weapons as Power-Ups!
Demo Update: AI Improved, Bug fixes
Demo Major Update: Handling improved, Tracks dedicated colors...
notes.notes:
V.0.3.0.0
- Handling is now way better! You can now turn sharp corners without braking or drifting!
- Track color system updated: Each track now has its own color palettes! This makes it more interesting to race in a different Bioms!

notes.title: Demo Update: 1 new Track, several new vehicles, Vehicle destruction improved...
notes.notes:
V.0.2.1.2
- 1 new Track + several new vehicles added
- Vehicle destruction improved
- Stability improved
- Configure amount of obstacles as you prefer

notes.title: Demo Major Update: Local Multiplayer, moving obstacles, power ups...
notes.notes:
V.0.2.0.4
- Local Multiplayer + Remote play together
- Moving obstacles
- Gamepad vibrations
- Visual: Outline shader. It modifies the look of each blocs by adding some outlines around them
- First Power-Ups
Everything can be activated or deactivated in the settings. Have fun, and let me know your feedbacks!

notes.title: Demo Updated - Bioms / Track colors!
notes.notes:
V.0.1.9.0
- You can now pick a color palette for the racing tracks, so it feels like driving in different biomes. So you can play again in the same track, and have even more variety than when only changing some of the models. There are specific sky colors based on the selected palet. Just click the random race button for fast configuration of everything, and/or pick your favorite color palet, sky colors, and models.
- I have updated the UI, so that the whole race configuration is more in a single place.

notes.title: Demo Updated - Better AI !
notes.notes:
V.0.1.8.4
- The AI characters are driving a more adapted & interesting way
- Rewarded models get automatically selected when unlocked
- During the race, the character names and rankings are displayed above the vehicles (which is particularly useful for the future local multiplayer version, that is currently under development and will be included in the Demo)

notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.notes:
V.0.1.7.0 Here are some new improvements in Crafty Racer Demo:
- The AI is driving more naturally and better
- The AI Models are more fun: mixed character combinations, and variable head and vehicle sizes
- There is now a "Shuffle" button for quick race configurations

notes.title: Demo Updated - Dynamic / Juicy UI !
notes.notes: V.0.1.6.0:  The UI is now dynamic, the shadows are nicer and I fixed some bugs in the ranking and replay!

notes.title: Demo Updated - AI Improved!
notes.notes:
V.0.1.5.0: Now the AI ​​is much better so it becomes much more fun!
And since it is no longer chaotic, the "2 ramps" track is back! It is one of the rewards to obtain in the challenges.

notes.title: Demo Updated
notes.notes: V.0.1.3.0: The Demo now contains challenges! You win extra models as rewards: characters, vehicles, startlines, checkpoints and direction signs!

notes.title: Demo updated
notes.notes:
Hey Crafters, I have updated the Demo of Crafty Racer -> V.0.1.2.0

Main changes:
	- I removed the 30 FPS limit, now it looks much better
	- I added a Tutorial
	- I have temporarily removed the "2 Ramps" Track, until the AI gets better, it was too chaotic. I will work on that and put it back.
